blocks.text: To enable the HTTP Header Control feature, contact Zscaler Support.

The HTTP header insertion profile allows you to add custom HTTP request headers and modify existing HTTP request headers. This feature consists of adding HTTP header insertion profiles and associating them to a URL Filtering policy rule.
The HTTP header insertion profile provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Create policies based on HTTP headers.
Add custom HTTP request headers to the egressing traffic with the allow action configured.

blocks.heading: About the HTTP Header Insertion Profile Page

blocks.text: On the HTTP Header Insertion Profile page (Internet Access > Policy > HTTP Header Control > HTTP Header Insertion Profile), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Search for a configured HTTP header insertion profile.
Add an HTTP header insertion profile.
Modify the column option to view the HTTP header insertion profiles accordingly.
View a list of all the configured HTTP header insertion profiles. For each HTTP header insertion profile, you can see:
Name: The name of the HTTP header insertion profile that is displayed when configuring a policy rule.
HTTP Headers: The HTTP headers (i.e., key-value pairs) that are added to the profile.
Description: The description of the HTTP header insertion profile if available.
Edit or delete an HTTP header insertion profile.
View the HTTP Header Profile page.
